book.noclip_backrooms.manila_guide.page1:
To whoever is reading this:

We are the Manila Mary Foundation, and we are here to help. Please take any food or Almond Water from the cabinet below and rest.

You have made it through the hardest part.
book.noclip_backrooms.manila_guide.page2:
This place is Level 0 of the Backrooms. Outside these tan walls, the halls shift when no one is watching.

Inside the Manila Room, the humming fades, the walls stay still, and wanderers can meet safely.
book.noclip_backrooms.manila_guide.page3:
The cabinet below holds supplies to keep you going.

Watch the yellow walls nearby: when a wall begins to flicker and crackle, step through to reach Level 1.

- In memory of Manila Mary

Shift Note - Upper Breaker Lofts

Whoever built the wiring above Level 0 hid secondary breaker panels inside the stair lofts above ceiling height.

book.noclip_backrooms.field_note.1.page1:
Observation Post - Above Ceiling Y=36

I stayed upstairs for six hours watching the yellow halls through the smoked floor panes. Nobody passed below, yet footsteps kept pacing in the next crawlspace.

C.L.I.P.P. protocol (Ariane Circle, Hermes team):
C - Check your environment for threats and the structure around you.

archive.noclip_backrooms.file.0.title: [CLASSIFIED] The Frontrooms programme
archive.noclip_backrooms.file.0.text: The Frontrooms are not reality. They are the first false exit we stabilised: those who return believe they are home, and stop looking for the real way out.
archive.noclip_backrooms.file.1.title: [CLASSIFIED] Field staff attrition
archive.noclip_backrooms.file.1.text: A field investigator lasts 4.7 cycles on average. Quota growth is set to match: just enough to pay, never enough to go home.
archive.noclip_backrooms.file.2.title: [CLASSIFIED] Wretch treatment
archive.noclip_backrooms.file.2.text: The institute's treatment suppresses the symptoms, not the cause. A cure is known and withheld. Reason: the cured do not go back in.
archive.noclip_backrooms.file.3.title: [CLASSIFIED] Search Team Seven
archive.noclip_backrooms.file.3.text: Search Team Seven went silent after finding, deep down, an exit M.E.G. had not sealed. Their last coordinates are top secret.
archive.noclip_backrooms.file.4.title: [CLASSIFIED] Beyond the wall
archive.noclip_backrooms.file.4.text: There is nothing outside the quarantine wall. Not empty ground: nothing. Field staff must not learn this.
archive.noclip_backrooms.file.5.title: [CLASSIFIED] Exit control
archive.noclip_backrooms.file.5.text: Every known exit now leads to the Frontrooms. Unknown exits: field staff are to report them when found, and we seal them.

radio.noclip_backrooms.wants: ...headquarters... this cycle wants... %1$s... %2$s of them... hsss...
radio.noclip_backrooms.debt: ...you owe headquarters... %s points... the outpost... closed...
radio.noclip_backrooms.squad.0: ...this is Search Team Seven... can anyone hear... we're at... hsss...
radio.noclip_backrooms.squad.1: ...the captain says that door isn't marked... don't report it... repeat, don't...
radio.noclip_backrooms.squad.2: ...left reports in the supply crates... for whoever comes next... hsss...
radio.noclip_backrooms.squad.3: ...outside the Frontrooms' wall... there's nothing... we climbed up and looked...
radio.noclip_backrooms.squad.5: ...every light in the car park went out... something is smiling...
radio.noclip_backrooms.squad.6: ...if you hear my voice calling you over... it isn't me...
radio.noclip_backrooms.squad.7: ...there's another floor under the institute... B2... the key is... hsss...
radio.noclip_backrooms.squad.8: ...day thirty-one... two bottles of almond water left...
radio.noclip_backrooms.squad.9: ...the exit isn't on the map... the exit is never on the map...
radio.noclip_backrooms.squad.10: ...down past the pipes... the hotter it gets... the closer...

radio.noclip_backrooms.fake.1: ...%s: I'm hurt... in the room behind you... help me...
radio.noclip_backrooms.fake.2: ...headquarters: the way ahead is clear... keep going into the dark...
radio.noclip_backrooms.fake.3: ...%s: don't go that way, there's something there... left... left...
radio.noclip_backrooms.fake.4: ...%s: I'm at the exit, waiting for you... the door's open...
radio.noclip_backrooms.fake.5: ...pickup has arrived twenty metres west of you... proceed... hsss...

anomaly.noclip_backrooms.silence.desc: Steps, doors and breaking carry further and draw what hears them (only creeping is quiet); creatures give up more.

anomaly.noclip_backrooms.mimics.desc: Some unopened crates are not crates.

No record of where this trip came in: the beacon cannot fix its position.
message.noclip_backrooms.field.beacon_re: Scan interrupted: the mapping beacon is back on you.

message.noclip_backrooms.field.beacon_st: The beacon is scanning: hold out %s seconds. Its beeps and flashes draw whatever is near.
message.noclip_backrooms.field.beacon_lo: The beacon was knocked out; the scan failed.
message.noclip_backrooms.field.beacon_do: Scan complete: Level %s's topology tape lies by the beacon.
message.noclip_backrooms.field.mapped: M.E.G. has Level %s's topology now: deployment there is free from now on.
message.noclip_backrooms.field.tripwire: Clank - the tripwire %2$s blocks to the %1$s.
message.noclip_backrooms.quota.photo_tar: This cycle's photo target: %s (photos worth three times as much)
message.noclip_backrooms.processing.hint: What you load is worked when you next get back alive, better the deeper the trip; the results go into your locker.

message.noclip_backrooms.anomaly.mimic_e: Bio-Scanner pulse! Disguise blown and stunned!
message.noclip_backrooms.anomaly.red_roo: The red mist condenses nearby into an anomalous Red Room...
message.noclip_backrooms.field.scanner_c: Bio-Scanner sweep clear: no mimic signatures nearby.
research.noclip_backrooms.gray: Tier 2: Military & Anomaly Engineering (9x9 Ultimate Spiderweb)
message.noclip_backrooms.research.locked: Locked: Analyze %s in the institute's Research Terminal first.

message.noclip_backrooms.ending.truth_co: All %1$s/%2$s Frontrooms truth files uncovered! Bring a Tier 3/4 Keypad Hacker to a B1 Transport Pad or deep Backrooms (Floor 3+/Level 3) for Ending B (/meg ending escape).
message.noclip_backrooms.ending.contract: Your medical clearance is clean. Ready to leave M.E.G.?
message.noclip_backrooms.ending.truth_hi: (You know the Frontrooms' secret. Override a B1 Transport Pad or run /meg ending escape deep in the Backrooms with a Tier 3/4 Hacker.)
message.noclip_backrooms.ending.need_cur: You must take the Wretch Cycle Panacea before M.E.G. will sign a medical release.
message.noclip_backrooms.ending.has_debt: M.E.G. refuses termination while your team still owes quota debt.
message.noclip_backrooms.ending.need_cle: Full institute clearance (%s quotas met) is required for contract release.
message.noclip_backrooms.ending.need_tru: You haven't uncovered all B2 archive files yet (%1$s/%2$s).
message.noclip_backrooms.ending.need_hac: Requires a Tier 3 or Tier 4 Keypad Hacker to override M.E.G. coordinates.
message.noclip_backrooms.ending.escape_w: Override coordinates either on a B1 Transport Pad (sneak-use with Hacker) or deep in the Backrooms.

Coordinate override active! Hold out %s seconds to punch straight through to the real Overworld!

message.noclip_backrooms.ending.escape_d: [Ending B] %s exposed the Frontrooms quarantine and broke back into the real Overworld!

ending.noclip_backrooms.contract.title: ENDING A: CONTRACT RELEASED
ending.noclip_backrooms.contract.subtitl: Wretch Cycle purged. Welcome back to the real world.
ending.noclip_backrooms.escape.title: ENDING B: TRUE ESCAPE
ending.noclip_backrooms.escape.subtitle: You broke past M.E.G.'s false Frontrooms into reality.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.pitfalls: You crashed into the Pitfalls undercroft! Follow the black arrows to find the escape ladder.
The damp undercroft stretches beneath the pits... look for black arrows leading up.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.event.ce: Nothing left above this ceiling tile.
The ceiling tile gives way in a cloud of dust and thunderous noise!
You reach above the drop ceiling and pull out %s.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.event.wa: Just a dull hollow cavity now.
Something scratches sharply right behind the wallpaper...
Behind the hollow wallpaper you uncover %s.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.event.gr: The black letters twist as you read: "DON'T TURN AROUND. YOU NEVER LEFT."
Black marker arrow scrawled on the wall: "AIR VENT / GARAGE -> %s"
Scrawled warning: "WHEN LIGHTS DIE, DON'T MOVE. VENT -> %s"
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.event.ut: Electronic shutter is dead — check a nearby industrial fuse box to restore power.
Power surges! A nearby locked utility shutter grinds open.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.event.ph: An unplugged phone somewhere nearby starts ringing...
Only dead air on the line.
Crackling voice: "...if you hear this... head %s... there's a way down..."
A piercing feedback shriek blasts from the receiver!
A distorted whisper answers in your own voice: "Don't look behind you."
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.event.cr: A nearby CRT television flickers to life on its own with violent static.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.event.ve: The vending machine hums weakly; nothing else drops.
The machine clunks and spits out %s.
The coils jam with a loud alarm chime and spray dark moldy water!
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.event.fa: You open the door... only solid yellow wallpaper sits behind it.
Dry fingernails rake the other side of the sealed wall as the door creaks!
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.event.mi: Your reflection points slightly toward %s before snapping back in sync.
Your reflection blinks a half-second too late...
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.event.sl: Your boot slips on the soaked, sticky carpet!
You catch your balance on the soaked carpet.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.event.do: Down the corridor, the fluorescent lamps snap off one by one toward you...
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.event.co: Haven't you walked this exact corridor already...? Try turning back.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.exit.pos: A damp faded poster depicts misty pine mountains and a 1980 lodge... (Tear down / break to cross)
[Insight] A 1980 Appalachian lodge time-loop poster — pine smoke drifts off the paper. Tear or smash it to enter Level 161.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.exit.win: Through the impossible square window stretches a pale courtyard of endless dark windows... (Right-click again to climb through)
[Insight] The Courtyard of Windows (Level 188) lies right beyond this glass. Right-click again to step across.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.exit.ste: Hot steam and metallic pipe groans rise beneath the rusted floor grate... (Right-click again to pry open)
[Insight] Pressurized utility pipes run right underneath — leads into Level 2 (Pipe Dreams). Right-click again to drop in.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.exit.oil: Cold concrete air and the smell of motor oil drift through the metal vent... (Right-click again to crawl in)
[Insight] A direct ventilation chute into Level 1's parking decks. Right-click again to enter.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.exit.car: The carpet corner curls up over dry, rotting wooden planks... (Tear / smash through to drop)
[Insight] Beneath this lifted carpet lies the wooden maze of Level 27. Tear or break it to plunge through.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.exit.pla: The peeling grey plaster rings eerily hollow when tapped... (Knock / smash again to break through)
[Insight] A thin spatial fault inside the hollow plaster (Level 194). Break or interact again to pass through.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.exit.mir: A wall-sized mirror reflecting a warped room that isn't here... (Keep staring or right-click again to step in)
[Insight] A spatial mirror threshold (Level 0.5). Stare closely or interact again to step across.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.exit.doo: Purple neon glow and distant bowling-pin clatter seep under this blue door... (Right-click again to enter)
[Insight] Retro music and neon lanes behind the blue door — Level 499 (Endless Bowling Alley). Right-click again to enter.
Fresh white paint smell and caution tape block a half-remodeled corridor... (Right-click again to step past)
[Insight] Backrooms Remodeling zone — Level 0.2. Right-click again to cross.
A wooden door suspended impossibly mid-wall with no stairs beneath... (Right-click again to open)
[Insight] An anomalous mid-air doorway leading toward Level 193. Right-click again to open.
A spiderweb-cracked glass door that refuses to show your reflection... (Right-click again to push through)
[Insight] Resonating glass fault leading to Level 13. Right-click again to cross.
Hollow echoes of clinking dishes drift behind these old double doors... (Right-click again to open)
[Insight] Empty echoing hall beyond — Level 68. Right-click again to enter.
The EXIT sign flashes an angry crimson red...
[Insight] WARNING: A crimson false EXIT trap leading into Level ! (Run for Your Life).
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.exit.gre: A faint green silhouette beckons down the hallway... follow it if you dare.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.exit.cor: The lights ahead flicker violently around a sickly green glow at the corridor's end...
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.exit.wat: Cold floodwater pulls at your ankles as the dark room tilts downward...
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.rain_orb: Faint rain patters softly inside the glass orb...
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.locker_e: This Omega locker was already looted recently. Bring an Alloy to trade immediately.
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.locker_o: Took supplies from the M.E.G. Omega locker.
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.vending_: The vending machine clunked out an Almond Water.
Insert a Lost Coin or Alloy to buy Almond Water.
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.shelf_em: Nothing unusual left on this shelf.
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.shelf_fo: Found an oddity tucked behind old binders!
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.medic_wa: The medic has nothing more to patch up right now.
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.medic_he: The M.E.G. medic patched your wounds and steadied your mind.
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.amor_hos: Amor Incrementum rejects outsiders! Show a religious relic or leave!
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.amor_pac: Amor Incrementum bows calmly at your religious relic.
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.amor_tra: Amor Incrementum exchanges refined fungal and almond goods with you.
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.amor_off: Amor Incrementum accepts your religious relic and grants purified essence, Almond Water, and spore sacs!
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.amor_hin: Hold a religious relic in one hand and an Alloy or Lost Coin in the other to trade, or offer the relic directly.
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.tbd_sold: T.B.D. silently hands over an utterly useless oddity.
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.tbd_hoar: A T.B.D. hoarder glares at you: "Personal stash. Not for sale."
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.tbd_hint: Bring 1 Lost Coin (or 10 account credits) to buy one of T.B.D.'s oddities.
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.window_t: Something knocks sharply on the bright window glass...
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.window_l: A dark silhouette behind the blinding glass taps and beckons you closer...
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.window_r: A pale handprint presses against the rainy glass, quietly luring you in...
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.window_g: Entity 2 lunges from the glaring trap window! Watch out for beckoning silhouettes!
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.window_t: The moment you touch the glaring glass, something behind it slashes you! Paint it with ink or charcoal!
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.window_p: Use Black Dye, Ink Sac, or Charcoal to paint this dangerous window black.
Painted the window black. It is safe now.
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.exit_van: You turned away... and the exit is no longer there.
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.smiler_r: A pair of glowing eyes flickered in the dark... or was it just a rumor?
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.breaker_: The breaker panel is still humming from a recent reset.
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.copier_j: The photocopier is warm and out of toner for now.
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.copier_p: The photocopier whirred and spat out leftover paper.
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.phone_om: Static crackles: "...Omega outpost is %s, about %s blocks out..."
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.phone_st: Only wet static hisses back through the receiver.
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.rain_sto: The rain outside the glass suddenly goes dead silent.
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.phantom_: A chair scrapes across the empty carpet behind you...
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.almond_p: Picked up Almond Water left behind in the office.
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.returned: Familiar office lights greet you—returned straight to your settled M.E.G. Base Omega.
message.noclip_backrooms.level4.wanderer: Wanderer: "Much safer ahead. M.E.G. Base Omega is %s, about %s blocks away—good place to settle and heal."
Wanderer: "Thirsty? There's a rainy atrium with an Almond Water fountain %s, around %s blocks out."
Wanderer: "Rainy glass out into the mist is fine, but stay away from blinding windows with a silhouette—Entity 2!"
Wanderer: "Wild stairs and odd doors here vanish once you look away. Only Omega's stairwells stay put."
Wanderer: "Those Amor Incrementum mushroom cultists attack outsiders on sight unless you hold a crucifix or icon frame."
Wanderer: "Those six T.B.D. hoarders keep all their good supplies for themselves and only sell useless oddities. Check Omega lockers for old relics."
Wanderer: "Bring Lost Coins, Alloy, office paper/circuits, or T.B.D. oddities—I trade batteries, Purified Almond Essence, Black Dye, and credits."
The wanderer hands you 2 Charcoal and steadies your nerves: "Black out any eerie bright windows." (+8 Sanity)
The scavenging wanderer slips you 12 credits and a Flashlight Battery Pack: "Bring office tech or T.B.D. oddities anytime."
The pathfinder hands you 2 Phosphor Powder and shares trail stims. (Speed & Night Vision)
The mapper shares surveyed floor notes and a Lost Coin with you. (+15 XP, +10 Sanity)
The drifter patches your wounds, clears your head, and hands over a Rough Bandage. (+6 HP, +10 Sanity)
The wanderer pockets your Lost Coin and hands over Almond Water, a Glass Bottle, and a Flashlight Battery Pack.
The wanderer takes the Alloy and trades Purified Almond Essence, a Sterile Bandage, and 2 Black Dye.
The wanderer takes 2 sheets of paper and trades 2 Charcoal and a Rough Bandage.
The wanderer eagerly buys that T.B.D. curio for 20 credits and a Sterile Bandage!
The wanderer salvages the office electronics and hands over a Lost Coin and a Flashlight Battery Pack.
Wanderer: "That's all the spare supplies I can trade right now. Try the water coolers or Base Omega."
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.manila.e: You step into the Manila Room — a faint warmth steadies your body and mind.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.manila.l: Leaving the Manila Room, that brief sense of sanctuary fades at once.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0.manila.b: [Manila Room Bed] Sleeping here sends you randomly to Level 1 or Level 2 — right-click again within 6s to sleep, or walk away.
Your eyes close as the fluorescent hum sinks into silence...
You jolt awake somewhere else entirely (Arrived at Level %s).
message.noclip_backrooms.anomaly.red_mis: You entered a Red Mist zone — sanity is draining, and an Anomaly Vault Chest waits inside...
You stepped out of the Red Mist zone. The crimson haze recedes.

item.noclip_backrooms.home_letter.text.0: Sweetheart, the institute says you're fine, just can't come home yet. We leave the door open for you every day. - Mom
item.noclip_backrooms.home_letter.text.1: The grass in the yard has grown again. Dad says he'll wait for you to mow it together.
item.noclip_backrooms.home_letter.text.2: The postcard you sent was blank. The postmark just says "Earth".
item.noclip_backrooms.home_letter.text.3: The neighbours say they saw you standing under the streetlight at night. But aren't you at the institute?

item.noclip_backrooms.home_letter.text.8: How many letters is this now? The mailman says nobody lives on this street.
item.noclip_backrooms.home_letter.text.9: Come home. The door is always open. (The rest is blurred by water.)
item.noclip_backrooms.home_letter.text.1: There was a picnic in the park today. Everyone was happy. They said you were there too.

message.noclip_backrooms.first_trip.refu: There seems to be nothing on the other side. The cable on the floor runs on...
message.noclip_backrooms.first_trip.door: The door won't open. The light in the gap is cold.
book.noclip_backrooms.cable_note.0.title: Cable Log (1)
book.noclip_backrooms.cable_note.0.page1: Day one. The four of us came in from the entrance paying out the cable, pinning it to the carpet every fifty steps. The lights won't stop humming. Kessler says the walls are moving. I said he's tired.
book.noclip_backrooms.cable_note.0.page2: Three reels of cable left. As long as we follow the cable, we can get back.
book.noclip_backrooms.cable_note.1.title: Cable Log (2)
book.noclip_backrooms.cable_note.1.page1: I don't know what day it is. Kessler went to look at a sound up ahead and never came back. We followed the cable to find him. It ends under a wall, as if the wall had eaten it.
book.noclip_backrooms.cable_note.1.page2: There are only three of us now.
book.noclip_backrooms.cable_note.2.title: Cable Log (3)
book.noclip_backrooms.cable_note.2.page1: We found the door. It's lit. The radio says it's safe on the other side and someone will come for us. The other two went through first. I'm staying here to wait for Kessler.
book.noclip_backrooms.cable_note.2.page2: If you find this, don't wait for me. Follow the cable to the end. Once you're inside, don't tell them what you saw.
quest.noclip_backrooms.lobby.title: Mapping the Lobby
quest.noclip_backrooms.lobby.reason: Commander: "You walked out of Level 0, so you can walk back in. We need a map of the Lobby to send a rescue team after the missing squad."
quest.noclip_backrooms.lobby.goal: Go to Level 0, set the mapping beacon down at least 300 blocks from where you land, let it finish, and come back alive.
quest.noclip_backrooms.lobby.after: The map is filed. The commander glances at it: "Good. It matches the squad's route." But by the institute's roster, those four never set out.
quest.noclip_backrooms.zenith.title: The Zenith's Echo
quest.noclip_backrooms.zenith.reason: Commander: "The Zenith Station on Level 0.1 is still transmitting. Go and see who is answering. Just look; don't touch anything."
quest.noclip_backrooms.zenith.goal: Reach Level 0.1 (the Zenith Station) and come back alive.
quest.noclip_backrooms.zenith.after: You report that nobody is there. The commander nods, unsurprised. The signal was using the institute's own call sign.
quest.noclip_backrooms.parking.title: Smiles in the Car Park
quest.noclip_backrooms.parking.reason: Commander: "When the power goes out on Level 1, something glows in the dark. We are studying how the lights disturb it. A photo will do; don't get close."
quest.noclip_backrooms.parking.goal: Go to Level 1, photograph a smiler, and come back alive.
quest.noclip_backrooms.parking.after: The photo is filed under "containment candidate", not "light interference". Behind the observation glass in B1 there seems to be one more smile.
quest.noclip_backrooms.pipes.title: Dogs in the Pipes
quest.noclip_backrooms.pipes.reason: Commander: "Hounds on Level 2 have chewed through our pipe readings. Put down two so the repair crew can get in."
quest.noclip_backrooms.pipes.goal: Put down 2 hounds on Level 2 and come back alive.
quest.noclip_backrooms.pipes.after: No repair crew ever went in. The hounds' bodies were taken away, though. There is a hound in a containment cell now, watching you through the glass.
quest.noclip_backrooms.power.title: Readings from the Power Station
quest.noclip_backrooms.power.reason: Commander: "The generators on Level 3 are putting out some kind of reading. Get there and back alive; the instruments on you will record it."
quest.noclip_backrooms.power.goal: Reach Level 3 and come back alive.
quest.noclip_backrooms.power.after: The reading on the instruments isn't voltage. It's a set of coordinates. The institute isn't looking for power; it's looking for a way out. Not one meant for you.
quest.noclip_backrooms.office.title: The Office Windows
quest.noclip_backrooms.office.reason: Commander: "Something is behind the windows on Level 4. We need a clear photo. This is the last thing; after it you can rest."
quest.noclip_backrooms.office.goal: Go to Level 4, photograph a "window", and come back alive.
quest.noclip_backrooms.office.after: "Well done. You can rest now," the commander says, without looking at you. The containment cells are full, and light shows under the door of B2's archive.
message.noclip_backrooms.first_trip.welc: Outpost commander: "Welcome to the M.E.G. Frontrooms institute. You have been in the Backrooms. That is enough."
"From now on you work for M.E.G. Don't worry. We will take care of you."
message.noclip_backrooms.quest.done: Assignment "%s" done. Get back to the institute alive to report.
message.noclip_backrooms.quest.pickup_of: M.E.G. can pick you up right where you are (it draws nothing to you). Stay put during the countdown.
message.noclip_backrooms.quest.pickup_no: There is no pickup to call right now.
message.noclip_backrooms.quest.come_back: This one is done; get back to the institute alive to report.
message.noclip_backrooms.quest.beacon: The commander hands you a mapping beacon.
message.noclip_backrooms.quest.finished: M.E.G. has no more assignments. B2's classified archive may hold something you ought to know.

contract.noclip_backrooms.survey_level0p: Survey the Zenith: reach Level 0.1 and return alive
contract.noclip_backrooms.photo_duller: The Silent Grey: photograph a duller in the Backrooms and return alive
contract.noclip_backrooms.survey_level4: Survey the Offices: reach Level 4 and return alive
message.noclip_backrooms.398.faceless_pa: The people without faces step aside. (%s / %s)
message.noclip_backrooms.398.faceless_st: You laid a hand on one of the people without faces. Tonight they will not step aside again.
message.noclip_backrooms.398.letters_mis: The people without faces have all stepped aside, but the end of the street is still dark. Some letter from home is still unread.
message.noclip_backrooms.398.door_lit: At the end of the street, a door has lit up.
ending.noclip_backrooms.home.title: Home At Last
ending.noclip_backrooms.home.subtitle: On the other side of the door is your own front hall. The light is warm, and nothing hums.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0p1.nav_ja: The singularity warps the station's field — your instrument needle spins aimlessly.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0p1.nav_ma: Static fills the paper; maps cannot chart Zenith Station.
message.noclip_backrooms.level2.house_ro: The room smells faintly of old plaster and linoleum, like an ordinary house...
message.noclip_backrooms.level2.konami_h: The pipes hum in an uncanny cadence — an invisible passage to The Hub aligns.
message.noclip_backrooms.level2.restroom: Beyond the steel door lies damp tiled masonry and running water...
message.noclip_backrooms.level3.gamma_ca: [M.E.G. Perimeter Security] M.E.G. has noticed you.
message.noclip_backrooms.level3.gamma_si: You unbolt the side door from inside and slip back into the tunnels.
Bolted from the inside. Use the north main checkpoint.
message.noclip_backrooms.level3.gamma_ha: The cobwebs stir behind the haunted house doorway... just a mall attraction, probably.
message.noclip_backrooms.level3.sanctum_: You take a charcoal rubbing of the unreadable inscription on the pedestal.
Unreadable ancient lettering is carved into the stone.
message.noclip_backrooms.level3.frantic_: Note 1/8: 'Don't trust the lights that buzz too high. When they go out, stay flat.'
Note 2/8: 'The angels keep them back. If you see stained glass, run for it.'
Note 3/8: 'Count the blue signs. Gamma is real. They have daylight inside.'
Note 4/8: 'Do not enter the assembly lines alone. Something waits by the bottles.'
Note 5/8: 'The red brick turns purple where they clip halfway through.'
Note 6/8: 'Three side doors, all bolted from inside. Only the north gate lets you in.'
Note 7/8: 'Check the blood at the gate. If it's clear, back away slowly.'
Note 8/8: 'Bring the rubbings and pages to the Archivist on the top floor of Gamma.'
message.noclip_backrooms.level3.archivis: Archivist: 'Bring me Sanctum plaque rubbings or frantic notes from the tunnels — M.E.G. pays for every record.'
